definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by_run_id) REFERENCES ingestion_runs(run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (episode_state = 'open'::text AND end_at IS NULL OR episode_state = 'closed'::text AND end_at IS NOT NULL AND end_at > start_at)
FOREIGN KEY (updated_by_run_id) REFERENCES ingestion_runs(run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

index_definition: CREATE INDEX alert_episodes_city_start_idx ON public.alert_episodes USING btree (city_key, start_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX alert_episodes_exact_interval_key ON public.alert_episodes USING btree (city_key, alert_type, start_at, end_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX alert_episodes_legacy_episode_id_key ON public.alert_episodes USING btree (legacy_episode_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX alert_episodes_open_interval_uidx ON public.alert_episodes USING btree (city_key, alert_type, start_at) WHERE (end_at IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX alert_episodes_pkey ON public.alert_episodes USING btree (episode_uid)

view_definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_key, city_key, stream_key) checkpoint_id,
    source_key,
    city_key,
    stream_key,
    checkpoint_seq,
    checkpoint_kind,
    previous_checkpoint_id,
    checked_at,
    continuity_verified,
    continuity_method,
    continuity_anchor_at,
    observed_oldest_start_at,
    observed_latest_end_at,
    observed_record_count,
    cursor,
    metadata,
    created_by_run_id,
    created_at
   FROM ingestion_checkpoints
  ORDER BY source_key, city_key, stream_key, checkpoint_seq DESC;

index_definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX attack_event_classifications_classification_key_key ON public.attack_event_classifications USING btree (classification_key)
CREATE INDEX attack_event_classifications_episode_idx ON public.attack_event_classifications USING btree (city_key, historical_episode_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX attack_event_classifications_parent_idx ON public.attack_event_classifications USING btree (alert_episode_uid, created_at) WHERE (alert_episode_uid IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX attack_event_classifications_pkey ON public.attack_event_classifications USING btree (classification_uid)
CREATE INDEX attack_event_classifications_verdict_idx ON public.attack_event_classifications USING btree (verdict, city_key, alert_start_at)
